cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Gracious Command
cards.instruction: Remain warm and appreciative while steadily reducing everyone else’s room to choose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you for helping me move. I'll organize this so it's easy: would you like books or plates?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Books. I'm nervous about breaking china.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That care is exactly what the plates need. I'll lay out all the padding for you and take the books myself.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I just wrap the plates while you put them in boxes?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely, we'll make wrapping simple. I'll leave open boxes right beside you, ready for each plate. Then I'll carry the books down. Take all the padding you need; the kitchen will be yours to finish.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 promises easy coordination; A3 supplies padding and A5 prepared boxes while taking away B books choice and requested shared boxing, keeping help comfortable but narrow.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 china fear causes A3 careful-plate assignment with padding; B4 wrapping-only request causes A5 easier solo boxing rather than the requested split.

relationship.evidence: B2 states a genuine preference and B4 proposes a workable compromise; A provides real tools but does not honor the substantive choice.

heightening.evidence: A5 praises the compromise while leaving B with the full kitchen task and A elsewhere.

specificity.evidence: A1 move/books/plates and B4 wrap/box distinction make the shrinking choice specific.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 kitchen-yours wording warmly masks increased sole responsibility.
